hub.releaseNotes: macOS focus fix, auth state buffering.

freecell.releaseNotes:
- Your level now shows beside your name (Lv 7) on lobby rosters, the race chip, round results, Top Players, and the daily and challenge boards, from level 2 up.
- "Step up" on the win screen now sits beside your quest: tap it to race the record holder on your next deal, tap again to change your mind. It no longer starts the deal for you.
- Coming back to a deal you left for ten minutes or more? A short note tells you its clock kept running.
- In a race against recorded runs, finishers stay in the order they finished instead of being sorted by name.
- A player's profile card opens in front of the Daily window, and the Daily board shows the same marks as every other board.
- A name on a board opens the "playing without an account" card only when the server says that player has no account.
- Security: player names and messages from the server are always shown as plain text, everywhere in the game. A name can no longer contain < > " ' & or a backtick.

minesweeper.releaseNotes: The board zooms: the mouse wheel zooms in and out, dragging a revealed square moves the board, and Fit returns it to the window. Your level shows beside your name (Lv 7) on rosters, results and boards, from level 2 up. Security: player names and messages from the server are always shown as plain text.
